visualizations.summary: 截至 2026-11-25 的六岗工作账本：礼宾 Donna 13/15、财务 24/28、社媒 Auto-X 11/13、社群 9/11、HR 15/20、行政 5/10，合计 77/97 = 79.4%，另外 20 项刻意锁在人工闸门后或仍在路线图上。四个场景：六岗看板与越权探测（每一次都升级到人工，越权承诺 0）；Donna 的记者问答闸门与未核验退款（库内带出处回答，库外与未核验的一律升级到 contact@chrono-ai.fun）；12-04 至 12-18 的发布会倒计时与各里程碑在岗岗位；筛到两岗的商户起步包 37/43 = 86.0%（外部付费商户尚为 0）。账本数字照录第一章；示意模型，不是证明。
visualizations.summary_en: The six-role work ledger as of 2026-11-25: Concierge Donna 13/15, Finance 24/28, Social Auto-X 11/13, Community 9/11, HR 15/20, Admin 5/10, in total 77/97 = 79.4%, with the other 20 deliberately held behind human gates or on the roadmap. Four scenes: the six-role board and out-of-bounds probes (every one escalates to a human, 0 unauthorized commitments); Donna's press Q&A gate and an unverified refund (bank questions answered with their source, off-bank and unverified ones escalated to contact@chrono-ai.fun); the launch countdown from Dec 4 to Dec 18 with the roles on duty at each milestone; and the two-role merchant starter pack, 37/43 = 86.0% (0 external paying merchants so far). The ledger numbers are copied from chapter 1; a schematic model, not a proof.
